title: Describe Everything
summary: Get n, mean, SD, median, skew and kurtosis for several variables at once with psych::describe().
hints: `describe()` returns a data frame with one row per variable, so `desc["satisfaction", "median"]` picks one cell.
`rownames(desc)[which.max(abs(desc$skew))]` names the most skewed variable, whichever direction it leans.
